messages:
Maya: quick thread — UX edge cases for vectors export modal. figma: https://figma.com/file/uvwx
Maya: items: per-file row limit wording, filename editing, keyboard flow, and 'include rerank' toggle behavior.
Ike - Eng: backend can split into parts (default 10k rows/part). we will append .part1 before zipping. gz optional. streaming only.
Ravi (PM): product stance: default export = id + embedding only. include-source toggle off by default. rerank toggle off for GA.
Maya: copy options for header i) "Export embeddings (CSV / JSONL)" ii) "Download vector rows and metadata" — which?
June - A11y: pick i). Also: modal must trap focus, progress announced via aria-live, and limit text needs aria-describedby. tooltips must be keyboard focusable.
Ike - Eng: implementation: show real-time size estimate beneath filename: "Estimated: 10k rows ≈ 12 MB (CSV)". warn and require confirm if >100MB.
Maya: UX question — when user edits filename, should parts use edited base? propose yes: userfile.part1.zip
Ravi (PM): yes use edited base. show preview and allow edit.
June - A11y: ensure preview input has sr-only label and that the preview updates are read to SR via aria-live.
Maya: small copy tweak for relevance table header: "Relevance score (higher is better)" per Sam's earlier note.
Ike - Eng: noted. will file INF-8522 for gzipping parts.
deploy-bot: snapshot uploaded https://redwood.design/snapshots/1770012345
Maya: I'll update figma and post a follow-up with final copy. :sparkles:
